description: This file defines a React component for editing a category in an e-commerce admin interface. It connects to Redux to fetch and update category data, and renders subcomponents for editing or showing a not found message.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: A React component for editing a category, handling lifecycle events to fetch data and rendering the edit form or not found message.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes the component by resetting the category state and fetching category data and products.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches category data if the category ID in the URL changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the SubPage component with either the EditCategory form or a NotFound message based on the category data.
